UserSubscription.title: UserSubscription
UserSubscription.description: Stores a signed-in Google user profile and their active ClutchClip Google Play Billing subscription status.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

email.description: Verified Google account email address of the subscriber.

displayName.description: Display name from Google Sign-In profile.

photoURL.description: Avatar photo URL from Google Sign-In profile.

tier.description: Active membership tier for this user account.

orderId.description: Google Play Billing Order ID (e.g., GPA.xxxx) or empty string if free.

productId.description: Google Play SKU ID or empty string if free.

paymentMethod.description: Payment channel label (e.g., Google Play Billing).

expiresAtMs.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the 1-month subscription expires (0 if free).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user record was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the subscription record was last updated.

/userSubscriptions/{userId}.description: Private per-user profile and Google Play Billing subscription document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
